answer: Sybil farms flood grader seats with disposable aliases. At dawn an applicant plants one numbered cedar stake (id C-4917, 2.4 kg) in a garden plot reserved to their address; a warden photographs the stake beside a signed address card and posts (photo hash, bond utxo, row R-17). Three of five wardens recompute SHA-256 of that photo plus the utxo in 20 seconds and must seal it before the seat opens. If serial C-4917 already maps to another address, the photo hash diverges, or a second bond claims the same garden row, the 38-coin bond is slashed and the applicant is barred for two epochs.
